state:
Subject: Appeal - listing LST-8812047 removed (Kids Glow Slime Kit)

Hello Seller Performance Team,

I am writing to appeal the removal of my listing for the Kids Glow Slime Kit, which was taken down on September 16 for 'missing required safety documentation'. I have sold this kit for almost two years with no complaints and over 1,400 positive reviews, so the removal was a real shock and has hurt our sales during back-to-school season.

I want to be transparent. When we switched suppliers in July, the new factory's test report was for a slightly different formula (the glow pigment changed), and I did not realize that the report needed to be updated. I understand now why this matters for a children's product. Our previous supplier's report is attached, and I have asked the new factory for an updated report from an accredited lab. They have told me it will be ready within 10 business days.

In the meantime, I have paused all inbound shipments of the new-formula kits to the warehouse and asked our team to quarantine the 300 units already there. Going forward, we have added a step to our supplier onboarding checklist so that any formula or material change triggers a new test before the product ships.

I would be grateful if the listing could be reinstated using the previous formula stock we still have (approx. 150 units, covered by the attached report), and I will submit the new report as soon as I receive it. Please let me know if there is anything else you need from me.

Kind regards,
Amara Liu
Brightbox Crafts (SEL-40562)
